Sidebar nav opens each page. SO56680 detail: hero SO56680, 4 stat tiles, line items totals $17.00 rendered correctly; order-so/order-invoice/order-back all work. Shipments: coo-toggle toggles with toast; scope filters work; search 'IS-0012' -> 1 row; IS-0012 detail: stages shows Released as current, requirements '2 of 2 complete', 3 doc buttons (COO doc appears only with coo on, verified toggling coo-toggle-detail off hides it), chat-send disabled empty, typing + Enter shows chat-msg-0 with 'Ryan M'; shipment-back returns; shipments-export downloads. Mobile 390px: orders/shipments/profile page-content scrollWidth==390 OK, BUT Resources page-content scrollWidth=532 (>390) -> horizontal overflow. Regression cart: SO55912 reorder correctly adds 24 units to cart (wolf+sheep exist in products.ts). NO console errors when clipboard permission granted.

ui_bugs.issue: order-reorder does NOT add 2 units for SO56680 as spec requires. Order lines 'The GOAT' (sku 101-0385-DEN01-O/S) and 'The Gorilla' (sku 101-0386-BLK01-O/S) do not exist in /app/frontend/src/lib/products.ts, so cart.add finds no match and toast fires 'These styles are no longer in the Marketplace'. cart-count element is never rendered (cart.count remains 0). Spec expected: '2 units added, topbar cart-count 2, toast'. Fix: either add matching entries in products.ts (The GOAT / The Gorilla with those SKUs) or change SO56680 line SKUs in orders.ts to reference an existing product.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...) is not awaited or caught. When permissions denied (default in some browsers/iframes), the returned promise rejects with NotAllowedError which surfaces as an 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay in the dev build, freezing the UI (blocked all subsequent tests until clipboard permission granted). Wrap in try/catch or .catch(()=>{}) — the notify() call should still fire but the promise rejection must be swallowed.

issues: `.page-content` scrollWidth=532 (>390) — horizontal overflow. Other pages (Orders/Shipments/Profile) all measure 390. The `.ac-files` grid or file cards likely use a fixed min column width that exceeds mobile. Ensure `.ac-files` grid-template-columns collapses to 1fr under 640px and cards use min-width:0/overflow-wrap.

action_items: HIGH: Fix SO56680 (and SO57017 / SO58739 which share The GOAT+Gorilla lines) reorder so cart gains units per spec — align orders.ts line SKUs with products.ts catalog, or add The GOAT/The Gorilla entries to products.ts.

MED: Handle clipboard write rejections in AccountPages.tsx (ResourcesPage share() and ProfilePage 'Copy account #') — the unhandled NotAllowedError triggers the CRA error overlay in browsers/iframes without clipboard permission.
MED: Resources page mobile — reduce `.ac-files` grid to 1 column and constrain file card width under 640px to eliminate 532px horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.ts line seed uses styles ('The GOAT', 'The Gorilla') not present in products.ts — silently breaks the reorder feature. Either the products catalog or the order seed needs to be reconciled; a runtime warning would help catch drift.
AccountPages.tsx: navigator.clipboard?.writeText is called without .catch — an unhandled rejection in dev mode shows the CRA overlay and blocks the UI. Same pattern likely exists elsewhere.

AccountPages.tsx F() component is defined inline inside ProfilePage render (line 84) — it re-mounts on every render, causing input focus loss after each keystroke in the address form (I confirmed keystrokes work but each fill was a discrete .fill() call; a real user typing may lose focus). Move F outside the component or memoize.
ShipmentsPage.tsx: `shipments` array is derived at module top level from orders (top-level constant). Fine for mock data but a real dataset should compute this inside the component.
MyOrdersPage line 91: `URL.createObjectURL` blob URLs are never revoked. Minor mem leak for repeated exports.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (2 spec deviations: SO56680 reorder count and Resources mobile overflow)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Grant clipboard permission before tests: await page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). Otherwise res-share-r5 / Copy account # crash the app with a CRA error overlay iframe that intercepts all clicks. 2) The .nav-item selectors work for sidebar items EXCEPT when you need the settings button — use '.sidebar-footer .nav-item:has-text("Settings")'. 3) SO56680 reorder is intentionally 'broken' by seed data mismatch; use SO55912 for cart regression (24 units of wolf+sheep, both exist in products.ts). 4) Mobile: sidebar/burger is not always present at 390px, but .nav-item elements remain clickable with force=True (they render offscreen in a collapsed sidebar but Playwright can still click). Body scrollWidth for Resources is 390 at document level but .page-content overflows to 532.
rca of the issue: Reorder failure RCA: MyOrdersPage.Detail.reorder() iterates order lines and does `products.find((x) => x.sku === l.sku || x.name === l.name)`. For SO56680 lines: {sku:'101-0385-DEN01-O/S', name:'The GOAT'} and {sku:'101-0386-BLK01-O/S', name:'The Gorilla'}. Neither SKU nor name matches any entry in /app/frontend/src/lib/products.ts (which contains p1–p12 covering Lone Wolf/Panther/Black Sheep/Alpha Dog/Goat Beard/The Cock/Panther Snapback). Result: 0 units added, cart.count stays 0, cart-count span not rendered. Mitigation options: (a) Add products The GOAT (SKU 101-0385-DEN01-O/S, $8.50) and The Gorilla (SKU 101-0386-BLK01-O/S, $8.50) to products.ts; (b) Change orders.ts SO56680 seed lines to reference existing SKUs like 101-2449-VOI01-O/S (Lone Wolf Trucker). Resources mobile overflow RCA: the resources file-grid card layout does not collapse to a single column below 640px — needs a media query in account.css to force `.ac-files { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }` and ensure `.ac-file` width auto-fits. Clipboard RCA: writeText returns a Promise that rejects with NotAllowedError when the frame lacks clipboard permission; the .? optional chain only guards against undefined, not rejection, so it becomes an unhandled promise rejection and CRA overlays a modal error iframe that intercepts pointer events.
